Reasonable Gun Belt for Outside the Pants Holster?
This is the one I bought. Works like a charm; sturdy, flexible.

I bought a custom made leather belt for ~$60 from a shop in my state. It's double-layer with a stabilizer running about 2/3rds the way around (so the back doesn't "droop" quite so badly). Been bomb-proof thus far (about 3 years now), even when I completely saturate it with sweat while working outside all summer.

I've had single-layer belts not last 1 year even withOUT loading them down with a firearm (daily wear). Maybe if you reserve the belt for unique wear occasions it'll last longer. In that case I'd suggest skipping leather all together and getting a nylon belt. Usually on the cheaper end and Zero wear issues (well, so long as you don't frequently walk through fires), you will absolutely get tired of the belt before it gave up on you.

I live by the idea of buying the best I can afford. You get a better product that usually last a Whole lot longer and in the case of things that can be sold again later, they're worth more.

I have one of these , it works great for my carry. Because it is micro adjustable no matter what clothing I am wearing I get the perfect draw pull. I never get the inch lift I had with my standard belt.
